# WebView2 SDK

Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet package 1.0.4314.35, published by Microsoft.
The unmodified Win32 header and x64 loader DLL are redistributed under LICENSE.txt.
Builds copy WebView2Loader.dll next to QtApp.exe. The installed Edge WebView2 Runtime
renders the website. No runtime installer is downloaded or run by Basis Code.
